existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: Condition has material local breaking changes. The top migration concerns are mandatory `clinicalStatus`, the `evidence` CodeableReference rewrite, and entered-in-error incompatibility. The main uncertainty is terminology: the local R6 core package lacks the external condition-clinical CodeSystem needed to verify the full R6 code expansion.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be organized around four workstreams: (1) status normalization and clinical governance for missing or entered-in-error statuses; (2) structural conversion of `Condition.evidence` between R4 backbone and R6 CodeableReference; (3) strict reference-target remediation for `stage.assessment`, recorder, and asserter; and (4) body location conversion between the R4 `bodySite` extension and R6 native `bodyStructure`.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for StructureDefinition-level deltas because both assigned StructureDefinitions were present and compared directly. Confidence is medium for exact terminology code deltas involving R6 `condition-clinical` because the R6 package references an external CodeSystem not present locally and no expansion service was used. Official diff pages and rendered narrative would improve rationale assessment but are unlikely to change the core structural findings.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Condition keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 4 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 2 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 47/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

4 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Entered-in-error Conditions changed from forbidding clinicalStatus to requiring it
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 entered-in-error Condition without clinicalStatus is invalid in R6; the R6 form with clinicalStatus is also not base-R4-valid under con-5.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Condition.stage.assessment no longer allows ClinicalImpression references
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 Condition.stage.assessment reference to ClinicalImpression is no longer allowed by the R6 target profile set.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Condition.clinicalStatus is now mandatory
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 Condition omitting clinicalStatus can be valid in R4 and invalid in R6; generated models and serializers also move from optional to required.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Condition.evidence changed from a BackboneElement with code/detail to CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 evidence.code/detail JSON is not the R6 CodeableReference shape; generated accessors and FHIRPath expressions also change.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds native Condition.bodyStructure and forbids using it with bodySite
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: native R6 bodyStructure must be mapped to an R4 extension for downgrade, and R6 forbids combining native bodyStructure with bodySite; there is no old-valid/new-invalid base break for ordinary R4 instances.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter allow additional R6 reference targets
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 instances using Group or Device actors cannot be represented as base R4 Condition actor references, but R4-to-R6 validation is widened.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Condition.clinicalStatus required binding now documents an `unknown` status
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: an R6 Condition using clinicalStatus=unknown will not validate against the supplied R4 required value set/code system, but existing R4 statuses remain acceptable in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Condition.category binding weakened from extensible to example
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: the conformance expectation is relaxed and may allow more coding variation, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid mechanism.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
